data.name: Sharvithan
data.gender_notes: Sharvithan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God who bestows wisdom and knowledge, Sharva is a form of Lord Shiva, the god of wisdom and knowledge in Hinduism. The name Sharvithan is derived from Sharva, and it is a name that signifies the possessor of divine wisdom. The name Sharvithan carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Sharvithan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine wisdom and knowledge bestowed by Lord Shiva, Sharvithan is a name that inspires one to seek knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Sharvithan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvithan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

It signifies the individual as someone who is bestowed with divine wisdom and knowledge, making them a vessel of the divine. The name underscores the importance of acquiring knowledge and wisdom in one's life, which is essential for spiritual growth and enlightenment in Hinduism.
